unverified_hypotheses.hypothesis: A visible phase boundary plus a priority takeover path makes high-frequency live output easier to understand and control.
support: NLM recommends phase-aware borders and a non-blocking action channel for Esc/Ctrl-C intervention.
against: The local TUI already has live-surface borders, phase rails, Markdown alert roles, a bounded render cache, and a biased keyboard branch.
unverified_hypotheses.experiment: Keep the existing renderer and event channel; add only busy-surface Esc takeover and a width-aware audit hint, then verify routing, discoverability, bounded rendering, and ConPTY takeover.

candidates.core: Treat plain Esc as immediate takeover only when the model is busy and no popup, approval, or panel owns the key; expose Esc/Ctrl-C in the held Inspector rail at wide-enough widths.
constraints: reuse the existing abort/commit takeover path
no second renderer or action queue
risks: Esc must remain a close/reject action on covered surfaces and must not discard an idle draft.
validation: Debug/Release ConPTY takeover and resize fixtures

recommendation: Accept the narrow Esc takeover slice; reject a second tokio action channel and a second Markdown/rendering path because the local event priority, abort path, semantic rails, alert roles, and bounded cache already cover those concerns.

next_step.value: Run the focused and workspace gates, then verify Debug/Release ConPTY behavior and retain the single Active Note.

stop_conditions: Do not intercept Esc while popup, approval, or panel precedence is active.
Do not claim a deep-research report or import without a task id and direct evidence.
Do not start another Ridge member; only capture notebooklm-mcp-maintainer.
